fieldValues.title: RFC-009 Change A: Add rootTypeRefs to DocumentView
fieldValues.proposed_change: Add optional rootTypeRefs?: ExactTypeRef[] to DocumentView. When set, the DocumentView applies to Containers whose typing anchor (Container.anchorInstanceId; RFC-009 Rev 6/srs#446) has a typeId/typeVersion matching any ExactTypeRef entry. ExactTypeRef requires both typeId (UUID) and typeVersion (integer >= 1). Multi-entry OR semantics. Soft-deprecates containerType to a back-compat hint. The anchor is always Container.anchorInstanceId, an entry of memberInstanceIds (RFC-043). Conformance rules I-63, I-145.
fieldValues.rationale: UUID-based anchoring replaces fragile containerType string join. ExactTypeRef is version-exact because the DocumentView-to-Container match is a package-validation-time claim requiring both typeId and typeVersion to resolve.
